Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 인사혁신처와 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원,「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 기획조정관, 국장 및 기획관 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「인사혁신처와 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Personnel Management and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established within the Ministry of Personnel Management and its affiliated agencies, the establishment and division of duties of auxiliary agencies and advisory agencies equivalent thereto placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination, Directors, and Planning Officers pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act.”
Chapter 2 Ministry of Personnel Management

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Deputy Minister) The Deputy Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(인재정보기획관) ① 인재정보기획관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Director of Talent Information Planning) ① The Director of Talent Information Planning shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.text_en: 9. Support for remuneration-related tasks in each ministry

3. Establishment and Implementation of Special Policy Education Plans

11. Guidance and Support for Negotiations on Overseas Education and Training for Public Officials
12. Management of Service Obligations for Personnel Who Have Completed Overseas Education and Training
13. Establishment of Performance Evaluation and Utilization Plans for Overseas Education and Training

rows.source_ko: 14. 국외교육훈련 공무원에 대한 훈련태도 점검 및 지도ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 14. Inspection of training attitude and guidance/support for public officials undergoing overseas education and training

rows.source_ko: 15. 공무원 인재개발제도의 연구ㆍ개선 및 관련 법령의 운영
rows.text_en: 15. Research and Improvement of Civil Servant Talent Development Systems and Operation of Related Laws
16. Operation of the Scholarship System for Civil Service Candidates

1. Research and Improvement of the Civil Servant Pension System
2. Analysis and Evaluation of the Long-term Outlook for the Public Officials Pension Finances
3. Reform of the Civil Servant Pension System and Education and Promotion

rows.source_ko: 4. 기업체 및 외국공무원 등의 연금제도 운영실태 조사
rows.text_en: 4. Survey on the Operation Status of Pension Systems in Enterprises and Foreign Public Officials, etc.
5. Guidance and support by the Government Employees Pension Service
6. Operation of the Public Officials Pension Management Committee pursuant to Article 79 of the Public Officials Pension Act

rows.source_ko: 11. 공무원 후생복지에 관한 종합계획의 수립 및 제도 연구ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment of a comprehensive plan for civil servant welfare and research and improvement of the system

rows.source_ko: 12. 기업체 및 외국공무원 등의 후생복지제도 실태 조사
rows.text_en: 12. Survey on the Status of Welfare Systems for Enterprises and Foreign Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 13. 공무원의 건강관리 및 교양ㆍ정서함양 등에 관한 사항

14. Establishment of a support plan for public officials scheduled for retirement

rows.source_ko: 15. 「공무원 후생복지에 관한 규정」 제2조제1호에 따른 맞춤형 복지제도의 연구ㆍ개선 및 운영
rows.text_en: 15. Research, improvement, and operation of customized welfare systems pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the "Regulations on Public Official Welfare Benefits"

rows.source_ko: 1. 공무원 평가 및 성과관리인사 제도의 운영ㆍ개선

rows.source_ko: 2. 성과계약 등 평가ㆍ근무성적평가제도의 연구ㆍ개선 및 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Research, improvement, and operation of evaluation systems, such as performance contracts, and work performance evaluation systems

4. Research on the Promotion System for Public Officials of Grade 5 and Below
5. Research on the Performance Bonus System
6. Education and promotion regarding performance management of public officials

rows.source_ko: 7. 기업체 및 외국공무원 등의 성과평가제도 실태 조사
rows.text_en: 7. Survey on the Status of Performance Evaluation Systems in Enterprises and Foreign Public Officials, etc.
8. Establishment and Implementation of the Operation Plan for the Level 5 Competency Assessment
9. Research and Improvement of the Level 5 Competency Assessment System and Competency Enhancement Program
10. Development of Level 5 Competency Assessment Model and Tasks

[Title amended June 3, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(윤리복무국) ① 윤리복무국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Ethics and Service Bureau) ① The Director of the Ethics and Service Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 윤리복무국에 복무과ㆍ윤리정책과ㆍ재산심사기획과ㆍ재산심사관리과 및 취업심사과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 6. 3., 2016. 10. 4., 2022. 1. 25., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Ethics and Service Bureau shall have the Service Division, Ethics Policy Division, Property Review Planning Division, Property Review Management Division, and Employment Review Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended June 3, 2015; October 4, 2016; January 25, 2022; August 30, 2023>
③ The Head of Service Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 12, 2015; Jun. 3, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공직가치 정립을 위한 연구 및 개선(인사제도에 관한 사항으로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Research and improvement for establishing public service values ​​(limited to matters concerning personnel systems)
2. Research and Improvement of the Civil Servant Service System
3. Verification and Inspection of Public Officials' Service Status

rows.source_ko: 4. 관공서의 공휴일제도, 당직ㆍ비상 근무제도, 공무원증제도 및 공무국외여행제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the public holiday system, on-call and emergency duty system, civil servant identification card system, and official overseas travel system of government offices

rows.source_ko: 5. 공무원 징계제도의 연구ㆍ개선 및 운영실태 확인ㆍ점검
rows.text_en: 5. Research and improvement of the public official disciplinary system, and verification and inspection of its operational status
6. Matters concerning the operation of the Central Disciplinary Committee
7. Management of Employees Dismissed for Misconduct
8. Duty Orders and Operations of the Duty Commander
④ The Head of the Ethics Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Oct. 4, 2016; Jan. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공직윤리제도 개선을 위한 정책과제의 발굴 및 국제협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the identification of policy tasks and international cooperation for the improvement of the public service ethics system

rows.source_ko: 2. 공직윤리 관련 법령의 제정 및 개정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the enactment and amendment of laws and regulations related to public service ethics
3. Stock Blind Trust System and Operation of the Stock Blind Trust Review Committee
4. Matters concerning the reporting of gifts by public officials
5. Operation and Improvement of the Comprehensive Public Service Ethics Information System
6. Investigation and Designation of Public Service-Related Organizations

rows.source_ko: 7. 공직윤리제도 운영에 관한 지도ㆍ점검 및 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Guidance, inspection, and support regarding the operation of the public service ethics system

rows.source_ko: 8. 주식 신규취득제한 제도의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the operation of the system restricting new stock acquisitions
⑤ The Head of the Property Examination Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공직자(공직후보자를 포함한다) 재산등록 및 재산공개에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the registration and disclosure of assets of public officials (including candidates for public office)

rows.source_ko: 2. 재산등록사항의 심사와 그 결과의 처리에 필요한 기준의 수립ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and management of standards necessary for the examination of property registration matters and the processing of results

rows.source_ko: 3. 재산등록사항 고지거부허가제도의 운영에 필요한 기준의 수립ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and management of standards necessary for the operation of the system for granting permission to refuse notification of property registration matters

rows.source_ko: 4. 공직자(제6항제1호의 대상자는 제외한다)의 재산등록사항 심사(재산형성과정 심사를 포함한다) 및 그 결과의 처리
rows.text_en: 4. Examination of asset registration matters of public officials (excluding those subject to Paragraph 6, Subparagraph 1) (including examination of the process of asset formation) and processing of the results thereof

rows.source_ko: 5. 정부공직자윤리위원회 및 분과위원회의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the operation of the Government Public Officials Ethics Committee and its subcommittees

rows.source_ko: 6. 재산등록사항에 대한 심사 기법의 개발 및 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Development and Research of Examination Techniques for Property Registrations
7. Matters concerning the training of public service ethics officers

rows.source_ko: 8. 정보ㆍ편의 제공 등 재산 성실등록 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning support for honest registration of property, such as the provision of information and conveniences
⑥ The Head of the Property Examination and Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Jan. 25, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 부동산 관련 중앙행정기관 및 공직유관단체 등의 공직자에 대한 재산등록사항의 심사 및 그 결과의 처리
rows.text_en: 1. Examination of asset registration matters for public officials of central administrative agencies and public service-related organizations regarding real estate, and processing of the results thereof

rows.source_ko: 2. 공직자의 재산형성과정 심사 대상자 선정 및 심사
rows.text_en: 2. Selection and Review of Subjects for Examination of Public Officials' Asset Formation Process

rows.source_ko: 3. 공직자의 재산형성과정 심사에 필요한 조사 및 관계기관 자료 제출 요구에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning investigations necessary for the examination of the asset formation process of public officials and requests for the submission of data from relevant agencies

rows.source_ko: 4. 재산형성과정 심사 기법의 개발ㆍ연구 및 확산
rows.text_en: 4. Development, Research, and Dissemination of Techniques for Examining Asset Formation Processes

rows.source_ko: 5. 부동산 신규취득제한 제도의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the operation of the system restricting new real estate acquisition

rows.source_ko: 6. 재산등록사항 심사 수임기관의 감독ㆍ감사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the supervision and auditing of the agency entrusted with the examination of property registration matters

3. Comprehensive Investigation into Retired Public Officials Who Have Taken Voluntary Employment

rows.source_ko: 4. 업무내역서 검토 등 퇴직공직자 행위제한 심사

rows.text_en: 6. Response to Administrative Appeals and Litigation Regarding Employment Restrictions

rows.source_ko: 제12조(기획부) ① 기획부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Planning Department) ① The Head of the Planning Department shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 기획부에 기획협력과 및 교육지원과를 두며, 기획협력과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 교육지원과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 12. 3.>
rows.text_en: ② The Planning Department shall have a Planning and Cooperation Division and an Education Support Division; the Head of the Planning and Cooperation Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, or Secretary, and the Head of the Education Support Division shall be appointed as a Secretary for Science and Technology or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 3, 2024>
③ The Head of Planning and Cooperation is responsible for the following matters.
1. Establishment and evaluation of major business plans and education operation plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육훈련 자료의 수집 및 중ㆍ장기계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Collection of education and training materials and establishment of medium- and long-term plans
3. Curriculum and Institutional Promotion
4. Overall management of the main website

rows.source_ko: 5. 도서의 구입ㆍ수집ㆍ분류 및 관리 등 원내 도서관의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the in-house library, including the purchase, collection, classification, and management of books
6. Management of internal organization and personnel
7. Internal Audit
8. Support for capacity building of public official education and training institutions at all levels
9. Promotion of cooperative projects with public and private education and training institutions

rows.source_ko: 10. 예산의 편성ㆍ조정 및 국회 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 10. Budget formulation and adjustment, and National Assembly-related affairs
④ The Head of the Education Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 30, 2021>
1. Security, Emergency Plans, and Management of Official Seals

rows.source_ko: 2. 공무원의 임용ㆍ복무ㆍ교육훈련ㆍ연금 및 그 밖의 인사사무
rows.text_en: 2. Appointment, service, education and training, pension, and other personnel affairs of public officials
3. Classification, receipt, dispatch, examination, compilation, preservation, and management of documents
4. Maintenance, Management, and Security of the Office Building
5. Management of dormitories and welfare facilities

rows.source_ko: 6. 용도ㆍ회계ㆍ결산, 재산관리 및 예산의 집행 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Duties related to expenditure, accounting, settlement of accounts, property management, and budget execution

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 원 내 다른 부ㆍ센터 및 기획부 내 다른 과의 사무에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters not falling under the jurisdiction of other departments and centers within the Institute, or other divisions within the Planning Department
[Wholly Amended July 27, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(리더십개발부) ① 리더십개발부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Leadership Development Department) ① The Head of the Leadership Development Department shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 리더십개발부에 신규자교육과ㆍ관리자교육과 및 전문역량교육과를 두며, 신규자교육과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 관리자교육과장 및 전문역량교육과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2019. 7. 23., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Leadership Development Department shall have the New Employee Training Division, the Managerial Training Division, and the Professional Competency Training Division; the Head of the New Employee Training Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary, while the Heads of the Managerial Training Division and the Professional Competency Training Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary or a Secretary. <Amended Jul. 23, 2019; Aug. 30, 2023>
③ The Head of New Employee Training is responsible for the following matters.
1. Overall management, coordination, and improvement of educational operations

rows.source_ko: 2. 각 교육과정의 강의장 사용에 대한 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of lecture hall usage for each curriculum

rows.source_ko: 3. 특별교육과정 및 기본교육과정 중 원장이 지정하는 과정 운영계획의 수립ㆍ운영 및 시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment, operation, and implementation of operation plans for courses designated by the Director within the special education curriculum and basic education curriculum

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 부 내 다른 과의 사무에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters not falling under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Ministry
④ The Manager of Managerial Training is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원 및 과장급 직위 공무원의 교육과정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the educational curriculum of public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service and public officials holding positions at the division head level
2. Other matters determined by the Director
⑤ The Head of Professional Competency Education shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 23, 2019>
1. Matters concerning the public service values ​​education curriculum

rows.source_ko: 2. 직무역량 제고 등을 위한 전문교육과정에 관한 사항(정보화 관련 교육과정은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning specialized training courses for enhancing job competencies, etc. (excluding informatization-related training courses)
3. Other matters determined by the Director
⑥ Deleted <July 23, 2019>
[Wholly Amended July 27, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(글로벌교육부) ① 글로벌교육부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Global Education Department) ① The Head of the Global Education Department shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 글로벌교육부에 글로벌교육과를 두며, 글로벌교육과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 4. 27., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 12. 3.>
rows.text_en: ② A Global Education Division shall be established within the Ministry of Global Education, and the Head of the Global Education Division shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or a Senior Secretary. <Amended Apr. 27, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 3, 2024>
③ The Head of Global Education shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국내ㆍ외국 공무원에 대한 글로벌 역량교육ㆍ컨설팅 과정의 개발ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 1. Development and operation of global competency training and consulting programs for domestic and foreign public officials
2. Planning and operation of international conferences in the field of human development

rows.source_ko: 3. 개발도상국 등의 교육훈련기관 대상 개발컨설팅 프로젝트 개발ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 3. Development and operation of development consulting projects for educational and training institutions in developing countries, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 국내ㆍ외 인적개발 관련 기관과의 교류협력 사업

rows.source_ko: 제2조(기능이관에 따른 공무원의 이체) 공무원의 인사ㆍ윤리ㆍ복무ㆍ연금에 관한 사무의 이관에 따라 이 규칙 시행 당시 안전행정부 소속 공무원 431명(정무직 3명, 별정직 1명, 고위공무원단 13명, 3ㆍ4급 4명, 4급 19명, 4ㆍ5급 23명, 5급 120명, 6급 113명, 7급 38명, 8급 22명, 9급 27명, 관리운영직 6급 1명, 관리운영직 8급 2명, 관리운영직 9급 31명, 전문경력관 가군 4명, 전문경력관 나군 7명, 임기제 가급 3명)은 인사혁신처 소속 공무원으로 보아 안전행정부에서 인사혁신처로 이체한다. 다만, 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조제2항 및 「안전행정부와 그 소속기관 직제」(대통령령 제25751호 행정자치부와 그 소속기관 직제에 따라 폐지된 것을 말한다) 제69조제1항 및 제71조제1항에 따라 총 정원의 3퍼센트를 넘지 아니하는 범위에서 공무원의 정원을 따로 정한 안전행정부 소속 공무원 5명(5급 2명, 6급 2명, 7급 1명)도 인사혁신처 소속 공무원으로 보아 안전행정부에서 인사혁신처로 이체하며, 이 조 본문에 따라 이체되는 안전행정부 소속 공무원 중 3ㆍ4급 “4”는 “5”로, 4급 “19”는 “18”로, 6급 “113”은 “114”으로, 관리운영직 9급 “31”은 “30”으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transfer of Public Officials Following Transfer of Functions)  In accordance with the transfer of affairs regarding personnel, ethics, service, and pensions of public officials, 431 public officials belonging to the Ministry of Security and Public Administration at the time of the enforcement of this rule (3 political appointees, 1 special appointee, 13 senior civil service members, 4 officials in grades 3 and 4, 19 officials in grade 4, 23 officials in grades 4 and 5, 120 officials in grade 5, 113 officials in grade 6, 38 officials in grade 7, 22 officials in grade 8, 27 officials in grade 9, 1 administrative and operational official in grade 6, 2 administrative and operational officials in grade 8, 31 administrative and operational officials in grade 9, 4 professional career officials in group A, 7 professional career officials in group B, and 3 fixed-term officials in grade A) shall be considered as public officials belonging to the Ministry of Personnel Management and transferred from the Ministry of Security and Public Administration to the Ministry of Personnel Management. However, five public officials belonging to the Ministry of Security and Public Administration (two at Grade 5, two at Grade 6, and one at Grade 7), for whom the number of public officials was separately determined within a range not exceeding 3 percent of the total number of officials pursuant to Article 29, Paragraph 2 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 69, Paragraph 1 and Article 71, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Security and Public Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” (referring to the one abolished pursuant to Presidential Decree No. 25751, the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies), shall also be deemed to be public officials belonging to the Ministry of Personnel Management and transferred from the Ministry of Security and Public Administration to the Ministry of Personnel Management; and among the public officials belonging to the Ministry of Security and Public Administration transferred pursuant to the main text of this Article, “4” for Grades 3 and 4 shall be deemed to be “5,” “19” for Grade 4 shall be deemed to be “18,” “113” for Grade 6 shall be deemed to be “114,” and “31” for Grade 9 in the administrative and operational position shall be deemed to be “30.”

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 상향 조정한 직급의 존속기한) ① 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 1의2의 정원 1명(서기관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 전산사무관 1명)은 2027년 3월 31일까지 존속하며, 2027년 4월 1일 이후 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 1의2의 정원 1명(행정사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 전산사무관 1명)으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The authorized quota of one person (one Secretary, Science and Technology Secretary, Administrative Officer, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Computer Officer) specified in Annex 1-2, whose job grade is upgraded by the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and the corresponding authorized quota thereafter shall be deemed to be one person (one Administrative Officer, Industrial Officer, Facilities Officer, or Computer Officer) specified in Annex 1-2.

rows.text_en: ② The five positions specified in Annex 1-2 whose ranks are adjusted upwards due to the enforcement of this rule (one Administrative Officer, three Administrative Officers, Industrial Officers, Facilities Officers, or Computer Officers, and one Assistant Administrative Assistant, Industrial Assistant, Facilities Assistant, or Computer Assistant) shall remain in effect until March 24, 2029, and thereafter, the corresponding positions shall be deemed to be the five positions specified in Annex 1-2 (one Administrative Assistant, three Administrative Assistants, Industrial Assistants, Facilities Assistants, or Computer Assistants, and one Administrative Clerk, Industrial Clerk, Facilities Clerk, or Computer Clerk).

rows.source_ko: ③ 이 규칙 시행으로 직급이 상향 조정되는 별표 3의2의 정원 1명(서기관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ시설사무관 또는 전산사무관 1명)은 2027년 3월 31일까지 존속하며, 2027년 4월 1일 이후 그에 해당하는 정원은 별표 3의2의 정원 1명(행정사무관ㆍ사서사무관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ식품위생사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관 또는 방송통신사무관 1명)으로 본다.
